scope.data: 13-row DESI DR2 compressed BAO mean and full covariance in unchanged mean-file order
scope.radiation_model: reference background with photons plus massless neutrinos at N_eff=3.046; this is not the exact DESI collaboration physical model (e.g. massive neutrinos are not represented)
scope.late_time_domain: flat background distances over 0<z<=3; no early-universe likelihood or sound-horizon prediction
scope.alpha: c/(H0*r_d) is an independent profiled BAO amplitude, bounded exactly by [1e-6,1e4]
scope.radiation_envelope: H0 grid is a sensitivity domain only, not a prior, posterior support or H0 inference
scope.envelope_limitation: extrema cover the stated finite H0 grid and the reported baseline/refitted optima; the entire shape domain was not exhaustively bounded
scope.claims: no posterior, evidence, significance or published-constraint reproduction claim

parameterization.quadrature: Gauss-Legendre 96 nodes (matching background_bao.py), independently checked with 192 nodes and scipy.integrate.quad
parameterization.alpha_profile: clip((q^T C^-1 y)/(q^T C^-1 q),1e-6,1e4); objective formed from whitened residual norm
parameterization.optimization: 16-start bounded L-BFGS-B over shape parameters; independent bounded differential_evolution with polish disabled; Powell checks on any active best-fit face; shape bounds imported unchanged from background_bao.FIT_BOUNDS
